name: Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: A mutual or one-way NDA for protecting confidential information

required_sections.title: Background
required_sections.description: Why the parties are sharing confidential information

required_sections.title: Obligations of Receiving Party
required_sections.description: How confidential information must be handled

required_sections.title: Exceptions
required_sections.description: What is NOT confidential (public domain, independently developed, etc.)

optional_sections.title: Permitted Disclosure
optional_sections.description: Disclosure to employees/advisers on a need-to-know basis

instance_inputs.label: Purpose of the NDA (e.g. 'evaluating a potential partnership')
